facts.business: Haryana Capfin Limited is a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) engaged in investment and financing activities.

auditor.name: Not stated in the provided text
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter regarding non-maintenance of Minimum Capital Adequacy Ratio of 15% as per RBI Master Direction for NBFCs for the year ended 31st March 2026.

key_risks: Non-maintenance of Minimum Capital Adequacy Ratio (CRAR) of 15% as per RBI norms
Significant related party transactions and substantial amounts owed to related parties
Assessment of carrying value of equity investments in subsidiary and fair value of other investments
facts.related_party_note: The Company has entered into material related party transactions and a substantial amount of assets are owed to Related Parties. This was identified as a Key Audit Matter by the auditors (Refer Note No. 24 and 36(9) of Notes to Financial Statements).
